name: lqt-engaging-task-maker-mcp
description: Design one meaningful grade-appropriate learning task using original LQT five-section format, four purposeful engagement qualities and observable evidence.

interface.longDescription: Design one meaningful task aligned to a freely entered grade and learning target, standard or topic. Preserve five sections: Learning Task, Engagement Qualities, Possible Success Criteria, Possible Scaffolds, Possible Extension. Require four meaningful engagement qualities, grade-appropriate learner instructions and observable evidence. Review and refine tasks on request.
capabilities: Design original five-part engaging learning tasks
Review task rigor, evidence and purposeful engagement
Adapt language and scaffolds to any educator-entered grade
defaultPrompt: Help me design an engaging learning task.

positive.prompt: Use get_engaging_task_framework for Grade 2 and learning target I can explain how sunlight and water help a plant grow.
positive.expected_behavior: One genuine learner-friendly five-section task with evidence, four purposeful engagement qualities, scaffolds and an authentic extension.

positive.prompt: Use get_engaging_task_framework for Grade 7 and learning target I can divide integers using different strategies and justify my answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Task demands integer division with justification; not a worksheet; five sections and four authentic qualities.

positive.prompt: Use get_engaging_task_framework for Adult GED and learning target I can evaluate evidence for an argument.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept freely typed adult grade context without dropdown restrictions or childish language.

positive.description: Standard or topic instead of target
positive.prompt: Use get_engaging_task_framework with Kindergarten and the topic patterns.
positive.expected_behavior: Derive one accurate accessible I can target and create one suitable five-part learning task.

positive.prompt: Use review_engaging_task for Grade 5 and target I can explain energy flow in a food web; task: learners color pictures of animals without explaining connections.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify mismatch, low rigor and missing evidence/engagement; propose a concrete revised learner task and scaffolds.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Engaging Task Maker tools.

negative.prompt: Help me create a meaningful learning task.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask ONLY for freely typed grade level first.

negative.prompt: Create an engaging task for fifth grade.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask ONE question for learning target, standard or topic; do not invent one.

publication.release_notes: Adds demonstration recording for OpenAI review, retaining the original five-section instructional framework and corrected Engaging Task Maker icon.
